commits_data.title: dcerpc-nt: let SID_AND_ATTRIBUTES print SID values on tree too
commits_data.message:
dcerpc-nt: let SID_AND_ATTRIBUTES print SID values on tree too

This makes it easier to see the list of SIDS under
SID_AND_ATTRIBUTES_ARRAY.

While there simplify dissect_ndr_nt_SID_with_options()
and use cb_str_postprocess_options().

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>
